body:
Projects settings aren't defined in `_bind_methods` by convention, they're usually more in the constructor.

But even there you'd likely run into the issue you're having with CI, where those settings are actually seen by `--doctool` because they're defined in a class that's not instantiated by the doc generation process. I'm not sure where to put them to be seen properly, maybe `editor/register_editor_types.cpp` (cc @KoBeWi ).

Sounds like something that should be editor setting instead.
But yes, `register_editor_types()` is where we define editor's project settings.

I think this is vastly more useful as a per-project setting, at least from the perspective I'm coming into this with, which was to give users a way to make a default that matches their project. Considering there is an option to Add Environment to Scene, there clearly was an intention to enable a workflow where users use the preview as a starting point and transfer into their assets. It wouldn't make much sense if, for example, different team members had wildly different starting points for the same game.
Yeah this is just another case where #69012 would be useful.
